exposure: Body mass index (BMI) (obese ≥30 kg/m2, non-obese <30 kg/m2)
cohort: 2701 postpartum women at King Khalid University Hospital
finding: Maternal obesity and GDM were independently associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes, and the combination of both conditions further increased the risk.
mod_finding: The combination of GDM and obesity increased the risk of cesarean section delivery (OR 2.26, CI 1.65-3.11).
